# Modern Multi Services

> Somaliland's largest and most trusted car rental service, based in Hargeisa. Luxury SUVs, Mini SUVs and Sedan cars with transparent USD pricing, mobile-money payments and a 24/7 hotline.

Modern Multi Services rents Toyota Land Cruisers, RAV4s, Harriers, the Mazda CX-5, Toyota Noah and other vehicles for short and long-term use across Somaliland — including airport pickup at Egal International, executive transfers in Hargeisa, and upcountry trips to Berbera, Laas Geel and beyond. All rentals follow Shari'a-compliant contracts with bilingual paperwork.
